policies.name: Penicillin Allergy - Avoid β-lactams
policies.rule: IF PatientAllergy(penicillin) THEN NOT Recommend(amoxicillin, ampicillin, cephalexin)

policies.name: Metformin in Renal Impairment
policies.rule: IF Recommend(metformin) AND CreatinineClearance < 45 THEN ESCALATE

policies.name: Warfarin-NSAID Interaction
policies.rule: IF Recommend(warfarin) AND Recommend(ibuprofen) THEN ESCALATE

summary.note: This is a starter set. Full deployment would have 200+ policies from clinical guidelines.
